zh-CN.title: 更流畅的照片和视频浏览
items: 照片与视频随手势滑动，缩略图跟随切换，退出沉浸模式后会恢复显示。
上滑照片可展开拍摄信息，下滑可退出预览。

en.title: Smoother photo and video browsing
items: Photos, videos, and thumbnails move together. The thumbnail strip returns when you leave immersive view.
Swipe up for capture details or down to close the viewer.
